assessment: Two testable substitutions; neither is established by the observations. Combined timing obscures the achievable saving. Preserve every accepted layout and exterior color, the footprint, assortment, rearrangeability, budget and delivery date; small samples cannot establish the 60-order success measures.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: an order-specific flat-pack carrier could perform component accounting and placement guidance. Each required partition occupies a labeled silhouette; matching removable labels identify its destination on the ordered-layout diagram. Empty silhouettes expose omissions, while the diagram directs customer assembly, including the short partition.
openings.delta: Moves completeness checking into the packing artifact and initial assembly from workshop labor to an artifact-guided customer action; fully assembled dispatch is a changeable assumption.
openings.prediction: If the carrier works, deliberate omissions are detected before closure, customer short-partition errors decrease, and workshop time falls without reducing completed-layout success.
openings.probe: Use six spare-board samples across ordered compartment counts and colors. Test seeded missing/wrong pieces, then ten participants assembling without help. Record selection, checking and packing times separately, final fit and assortment capacity, and transport protection. Price the carrier and preparation time before any order change.
assumptions: Carrier contents and diagram are generated correctly from each order.
Packaging changes stay within both cost limits and the fixed delivery date.

openings.claim: Short tapered lead-ins on partition tabs might transfer insertion alignment from repeated hand adjustment into the tab geometry, retaining the original seated engagement surfaces and removable joint.
openings.delta: The material guides initial entry; overlapping recorded widths do not establish whether alignment causes retries.
openings.prediction: Alignment-driven retries should decline with tapered entry, including among parts with overlapping widths; unchanged retries weaken this explanation.
openings.probe: Use six modified samples and three unchanged controls. Counterbalance insertion order across workers and participants; record retries and insertion time separately. Check retention under the specified assortment and repeated dismantling. Adopt only if template work fits the budget and delivery date.
assumptions: Existing templates permit a short lead-in without weakening seated joints.
Insertion savings materially affect total workshop time.
